[LGRA.2.5.2] `NAME` is the **single** identifier terminal — bindings, slot
names, constants, and schema / type references all lex as `NAME`. An
identifier's role (type reference versus binding) is fixed by grammatical
**position**, not by case ([LGRA.22]). A `NAME` never carries a unit glyph; a
type spelled with a non-XID glyph (`slot: °C`, `x::°C`) lexes `TYPE_SYM`.
